login.title: Tsena ya Molekane wa Tšhanele
login.welcome: O amogetswe gape! Saenela go laola batho ba ba go batlang.
login.heroTitle: Godisa kgwebo ya gago ya ditsha ka moeteledipele mongwe le mongwe yo o mo tlisang
login.heroIntro: Portal e le nngwe ya go kwadisa bareki le baagi, boloka sekoloto sa baeteledipele ba gago le go ba sala morago go fitlha ba dira dipeeletso.

register.title: Kwadisa dikeletso mo metsotswaneng
register.text: Romela khasetomara ya gago le porojeke e a nang le kgatlhego mo go yone.

protect.title: Tshireletso ya poeletso
protect.text: Moeteledipele wa gago o nna wa gago ka nako ya tshireletso, ka jalo ga go ope yo mongwe yo o ka kopang khasetomara e e tshwanang.

track.title: Latedisa kgato nngwe le nngwe
track.text: Bona seemo sa moeteledipele mongwe le mongwe le hisitori e e feletseng, go tswa mo go ikgolaganyeng le ene la ntlha go fitlha ka go buka.

handover.title: Sekoloto fa o beeletsa
handover.text: Fa moreki a buka, ketapele e neelwa moagi le wena o kwadilwe jaaka molekane wa motswedi.

login.secure: Go tsena ka pabalesego - dintlha tsa dikhasetomara tsa gago di nna tsa sephiri
login.builderLink: Saenela go tsena mo kgorong ya moagi

signup.title: Kwadiso ya Molekane wa Tšhanele
signup.intro: Tlhama akhaonto ya gago go simolola go ikwadisa le go laola batho ba ba ka nnang ba go batla.
signup.password: Nomoro ya sephiri * (motsotso wa ditlhaka di le 8)
signup.haveAccount: A o setse o na le akhaonto?
